Scenario recording coverage

The nine named separator-method probes in each edition completed public execution. Eight methods are unsupported in those probes, one is inapplicable, and none of the nine journals uses a tool.

Keep the recorded pointing or set-down behavior in its own player. A successful episode or visible orange object does not establish levering, axle pushing, or a successful separator method.

Authored method and actual public action journal · v6-2026-11-17 nine separate public method replays

39 of 50 registered cases have same-edition footage. 39 distinct recordings are linked here across 36 authored scenario types.

39 cases have footage of the primary input. 0 separately recorded clips show variants, prefixes or diagnostic context. The camera evidence includes 0 milestone recordings and 39 historical rerenders.

The type table identifies conditions and cues reached in a filmed run. Each card lists what reviewers could see at specific frames.

Model pictures above are existing gallery references, not new episode evidence. Each player carries its recorded render and validation status. Synthetic development fixtures are excluded from this player gallery.

A rendered video does not certify motion or human contact. Failed checks remain visible. Unsupported probes and separator context videos do not count as demonstrated scenarios. This is representative coverage, not exhaustive rendering of every applicable combination.

Opening this report

Open this HTML file in a web browser for video playback. Some editor previews block scripts or media. All episode cards and evidence links are included directly in the HTML; filters and in-page seeking use JavaScript.

For a local web server with video seeking, run from the repository root:

cd /mnt/d/legosim
python3 -m legosim.cli.serve

Open this edition’s scenario catalog at /report/v6-2026-11-17/site/report/scenarios/index.html.

  • 0:06.50 The right hand is apart again. A white rectangular build remains uncovered between the hands.
